stages.reference:
Create a visual reference from a grounded dark-fantasy world where materials feel ancient, weathered, tactile, and physically believable.

The world is old and shaped by climate, pressure, water, decay, craft, use and survival. Materials should have authored depth, restrained color, irregularity and age without becoming theatrical, sterile, plastic or generically photoreal.

Create a close visual study centered specifically on grey dyed wool as a dense felted/interwoven textile block: matte compressed fibers, subtle irregular weave/fuzz and believable dye penetration, preserving the grey identity without plastic smoothness.

Treat this exact material, face, state or construction as its own visual problem. Do not copy a low-resolution game texture and do not reduce the task to a generic family template. Interpret how this exact surface would physically exist in the shared world. Let structure, age, tonal variation, wear, imperfections, layering, moisture/dryness where appropriate, and material character emerge naturally.

Prioritize material presence, surface depth, natural variation, age, visual richness and cohesive artistic identity. No scene narrative, characters, props, text or interface. Produce a definitive material reference suitable for guiding a game-texture rebuild.
